title: Interfaces and Modules: A Scalable Representation for Weight-Space Learning across Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2610.21995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight-space learning across architectures requires representations that respect parameter symmetries and scale to large networks. Existing equivariant tensor encoders require architecture-specific symmetry specifications, while neuron graphs make global attention costly. We introduce a typed graph organized around shared coordinate-permutation actions. Its nodes, called interfaces, represent coordinate spaces whose bound tensor axes must be permuted jointly; operation occurrences, called modules, form typed hyperedges. A compiler derives this graph from supported PyTorch models, with exact recovery of the permutation factors defined by its constraints. The Universal Weight Encoder (UWE) combines local equivariant updates to parameter features with global attention over invariant interface summaries. translated_title: 接口与模块：一种跨架构权重空间学习的可扩展表示
translated_abstract: 跨架构的权重空间学习需要既尊重参数对称性、又能扩展到大型网络的表示方法。现有的等变张量编码器需要针对特定架构指定对称性，而神经元图则使全局注意力的计算代价过高。我们提出了一种围绕共享坐标置换作用组织的类型化图。其节点被称为“接口”，表示其绑定的张量轴必须被联合置换的坐标空间；操作的具体出现被称为“模块”，构成类型化的超边。一个编译器可以从受支持的 PyTorch 模型中自动推导出该图，并精确恢复由其约束所定义的置换因子。通用权重编码器（UWE）将对参数特征的局部等变更新与对不变接口摘要的全局注意力相结合。由于接口数量很少，全局注意力变得切实可行，并且单个编码器即可处理不同的受支持架构。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种以“接口”（坐标置换空间）和“模块”（操作超边）为基本单元的类型化图表示，并构建了通用权重编码器（UWE），通过局部等变更新与接口摘要上的全局注意力相结合，实现了尊重参数对称性且可扩展、可跨架构的权重空间学习。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a typed graph representation of interfaces (coordinate-permutation spaces) and modules (operation hyperedges), along with the Universal Weight Encoder (UWE), which combines local equivariant updates with global attention over invariant interface summaries to achieve symmetry-respecting, scalable weight-space learning across different architectures.
